metadata.selection_note: Two selection layers, both inherited from the source and neither under this project's control. (a) The source states the 101 were picked from a much larger production pool on simplicity grounds, and that 80 were in production at publication; the effective multiple-testing burden behind them is therefore far larger than 101. (b) This corpus retains 50 of the 101 on data availability and execution convention only - never on performance. See control_group_manifest.csv for the per-alpha decision.
metadata.source_citation: Kakushadze, Z. (2016). 101 Formulaic Alphas. Wilmott Magazine 2016(84), 72-80. arXiv:1601.00991
